title: `dt.offset_by` on a zoned `Datetime` follows the column's time zone
verdict: a day added across a DST change keeps the wall clock of the column's zone
description: `Datetime("us", "UTC")` 2024-03-30 11:00, converted to Europe/Berlin and offset by `1d`, is 2024-03-31 10:00 UTC: the day is a calendar day of the column's zone (CET to CEST), not 24 hours. Calendar arithmetic on an instant depends on the zone the column carries, which a plan does not state.
reference: `Kind.timeTz` is refused: the reference's calendar arithmetic on instants would need a time zone the plan does not carry.
